result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Start, inspect or stop the background process that hosts management and the 
gateway

USAGE:
    ar service [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    ar service start
    ar service stop
    ar service status
    ar service pause
    ar service resume

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    start     Run management and inference in background, or reuse a verified   
              service. Exit 0 means management is available; use service status 
              to check inference readiness                                      
    stop      Stop the background service and its gateway after active requests 
              finish                                                            
    status    Show management availability and live inference state separately, 
              with listener addresses and failure details. Exit 0 means         
              management is available even when inference is Stopped or Failed  
    pause     Drain active model requests and stop the inference listener.      
              Management and configuration APIs stay available. Use service     
              resume to start model handling again; requires a running service  
    resume    Start stopped inference using saved settings without restarting   
              management. Already-running inference is reused, not reconfigured;
              use service reload to apply changes. Requires a running service   
    reload    Validate saved settings, drain active requests and restart only   
              inference; management stays available. Invalid settings leave     
              running inference unchanged; a later startup failure can leave    
              inference stopped. Also starts stopped inference. Not seamless hot
              reload                                                            
    serve     Run management and gateway in this terminal, for debugging or a   
              process supervisor
